title: The AWS Cleanup We Keep Putting Off (I Let an Agent Do It)
excerpt: Forgotten AWS resources quietly cost you money, and the cleanup is the chore everyone puts off. Here's how I cleared out old CloudFormation stacks by chatting with an agent, worked around a stack that refused to delete, then had it scan my whole account for the leftovers actually running up the bill.
content_html:
It started with a billing alert.

Estimated charges had crossed $250. Not scary money, but enough to make me look. And what actually caught my attention wasn't the number, it was the alert itself. I'd clearly set this up at some point, and the threshold felt stale.

So I went looking for where the alert lived.

It came from a BillingAlerts CloudFormation stack I created back in 2014 and completely forgot about. So a thing I forgot about was warning me about all the other things I'd forgotten about.

I opened my stack list and that's when I saw it wasn't alone. It was sitting in a lineup of stacks, and I didn't recognise half of them. Years of leftovers, just sitting there.

The stuff you forget about doesn't break anything. It doesn't page you at 2am. It just sits there, quietly billing, until you glance at the invoice and can't remember what half of it is for. Forgotten, still-running resources are one of the biggest sources of wasted cloud spend, by some estimates around a quarter of the average cloud budget.

I came to update one alert and I found a mess.

To be clear, these stacks weren't really costing me much. Stopped instances, a few half-deleted leftovers. If they'd been the $252, the alert would've tripped every month. But that's the point. You can't tell what's actually costing you until the clutter is gone.

So the alert could wait. I wanted these stale stacks gone first.

Normally this is a chore. Open the console, find each stack, click delete, wait, refresh, check if it worked, OR write out CLI commands. It's not hard, just tedious. The kind of task I keep putting off.

And that's exactly how this started. ClickOps through the console. I'd just finished deleting an old Directory Service directory over in the Mumbai region by hand, clicking through the screens and waiting out the spinner, when it hit me. Barely ten minutes of manual clicking, and I still had a pile of stacks to go. I didn't have to do any of this myself.

Why was I still clicking?

I opened Kiro, which has the Agent Toolkit for AWS, and just described what I wanted. I talked about how I set it up earlier in my blog I Switched to the Agent Toolkit for AWS. Here's Why.

No console. No CLI. I had a chat with the agent and let it take care of the rest. Like a good assistant!

If you have AWS CLI installed, just run:

aws configure agent-toolkit

It will let you select agents to configure with Agent Toolkit:

First, show me what's there

I started by asking the agent to list my CloudFormation stacks in my region.

It came back with 12 stacks. Some I recognised, while some were ancient, a billing-alerts stack from 2014, a few patching and compliance stacks from 2021, the CDK bootstrap toolkit. And then the ones I actually wanted gone.

I picked and told the agent to delete four of these stacks.

It asked before it deleted

This matters, so I want to call it out first.

The agent didn't just start deleting things the moment I asked. Before it ran anything, it listed the four stacks back to me, told me plainly that this would remove all their resources and couldn't be easily undone, and asked me to confirm.

Deleting infrastructure is not reversible.

I said go and then it acted.

I got the speed of "just handle it" without giving up the checkpoint on a destructive action.

It checked the result as code, no refreshing the console every second

Once the delete requests were in, the agent wrote a script and ran it in the toolkit's sandbox to check the status of all four at once.

It checked all four in parallel, handled the case where a stack might already be gone, and gave me back a clean status map. All of it ran in a remote sandbox with boto3. My machine never executed any of it.

Three deleted cleanly but one refused.

The fourth stack, aws-sam-cli-managed-default, came back DELETE_FAILED.

So, the agent pulled the stack events to find out why. The failure pointed at one resource, the S3 bucket SAM uses for deployment artifacts (SamCliSourceBucket). The message was specific:

The bucket you tried to delete is not empty. You must delete all versions in the bucket.

This bucket had versioning enabled. So "empty the bucket" isn't enough. Every object version and every delete marker has to go, or CloudFormation still can't remove the bucket. That's why a quick "empty" in the console sometimes doesn't fix it.

The agent explained the cause, then offered to empty the bucket properly and retry. I said yes.

That whole detour, remembering the versioned-bucket gotcha, hunting down the bucket name, realising delete markers count too, emptying it manually, then coming back to retry, is the part I'd normally slog through myself. The agent connected the failed delete to the full bucket and just handled it.

All four gone.

Why this felt different

Let me be clear about what actually changed here, because "I used AI to delete some stacks" is not the point.

The point is the whole loop stayed in one place. I described the goal in plain language. The agent listed the real state of my account, confirmed the destructive step, ran the code to do it, and then debugged and fixed the one thing that broke without me digging through docs.

A few things made that possible:

It ran real code, safely. The toolkit gives the agent a sandboxed Python runtime with boto3. It can check state, filter, and act in a few lines, without running anything on my laptop.

It confirmed the risky part. Deletes are one-way. The agent treated them that way and checked with me first.

It handled the failure end to end. The console wouldn't have left me stuck here. On a DELETE_FAILED, it pops up and lets me retry, either retaining the bucket (orphaning it in my account) or bouncing over to the S3 console to empty it myself. Both are context switches, and "retain" just leaves the bucket behind. The agent skipped all that. It read the stack events, found the versioned bucket, emptied it properly (versions and delete markers), and retried, without me leaving the chat or orphaning anything.

Everything is auditable. Because this all goes through the managed AWS MCP Server, every call lands in CloudTrail. More on that next.

I could see every call in CloudTrail

This is the part that turns "I let an agent delete my infrastructure" from scary into fine.

Every action the agent took went through the managed AWS MCP Server, and every one of those calls shows up in CloudTrail. I went and looked. All four DeleteStack events are right there under my identity, and they carry a clear fingerprint:

eventName:        DeleteStack
userIdentity:     gaonkarr
sourceIPAddress:  aws-mcp.amazonaws.com
userAgent:        aws-mcp.amazonaws.com

That aws-mcp.amazonaws.com value is how you tell agent actions apart from your own. Earlier the same day I'd deleted some stacks by hand in the console, and those events look completely different: a real browser user agent and my actual IP address. So the audit trail shows who really did what, my clicks versus the agent acting on my behalf.

Here are the five DeleteStack events from this cleanup, straight out of CloudTrail:

Time (UTC) Stack Identity Source IP User Agent
14:23:18 CdkPipelineStack gaonkarr aws-mcp.amazonaws.com aws-mcp.amazonaws.com
14:23:18 buildon-sam-app gaonkarr aws-mcp.amazonaws.com aws-mcp.amazonaws.com
14:23:18 aws-sam-cli-managed-default (1st attempt) gaonkarr aws-mcp.amazonaws.com aws-mcp.amazonaws.com
14:23:19 sam-app gaonkarr aws-mcp.amazonaws.com aws-mcp.amazonaws.com
14:24:19 aws-sam-cli-managed-default (retry) gaonkarr aws-mcp.amazonaws.com aws-mcp.amazonaws.com

The retry is right there in the trail. The aws-sam-cli-managed-default delete shows up twice: once when it failed, and again about a minute later when the agent retried after emptying the bucket. The whole failed-then-fixed sequence is preserved.

One honest caveat worth knowing: the DeleteStack calls are management events, which CloudTrail logs by default. But the S3 DeleteObjects calls that actually emptied the bucket are data events, and those are not logged unless you've turned on data event logging for that bucket. So I could see the stack deletions clearly, but not the individual object deletions. If you want object-level actions in your trail, you have to enable S3 data events first.

What's next for me

Deleting four stacks felt good. So I got curious and asked the agent:

can you scan through my AWS account and identify any leftover resources?

It scanned common services in my account. First the default region, then it expanded to the others. 4 more pages of listing. 🫣

It found a significant number of leftover resources from workshops, demos, and old projects, and gave me a Cost Impact Summary.

  • 3 stopped EC2 instances, oldest one from 2021.

  • 14 unattached EBS volumes, some created back in 2014, still quietly billing for storage attached to nothing.

  • 5 Elastic IPs sitting unassociated, roughly $18 a month for addresses doing no work.

  • 122 S3 buckets, a load balancer I forgot about, 16 Lambda functions all on runtimes that hit end of life years ago.

None of it broke anything. That's exactly why it survived this long.

Finding all of that is usually the hardest part. Clicking through every service, in every region, one console at a time, is the reason I never do this. It's hours of tedious work before you've deleted a single thing. This time I asked once, and the agent handed me the whole list.

The task that always felt too big to start is now the easy part.

So I'm going to clean it up with help of my new assistant.

If your account is anything like mine, it should probably be yours too.

Disclaimer:

Please be specific with your agent on what you want to delete. Deleting is irreversible action and should only be done carefully!

Tell me what you find in there. I'd bet I am not the only one who forgot about it.

Follow along

sentences.en: Some I recognised, while some were ancient, a billing-alerts stack from 2014, a few patching and compliance stacks from 2021, the CDK bootstrap toolkit.
sentences.zh: 有些是我认识的，有些是古老的，2014 年的计费警报堆栈，2021 年的一些补丁和合规堆栈，CDK 引导工具包。

sentences.en: And then the ones I actually wanted gone.
sentences.zh: 然后我真正想要的那些就消失了。

blocks.html_en: I picked and told the agent to delete four of these stacks.

sentences.en: I picked and told the agent to delete four of these stacks.
sentences.zh: 我选择并告诉代理删除其中四个堆栈。

blocks.html_en: It asked before it deleted

sentences.en: It asked before it deleted
sentences.zh: 删除前询问过

blocks.html_en: This matters, so I want to call it out first.

sentences.en: This matters, so I want to call it out first.
sentences.zh: 这很重要，所以我想先指出这一点。

blocks.html_en: The agent didn't just start deleting things the moment I asked. Before it ran anything, it listed the four stacks back to me, told me plainly that this would remove all their resources and couldn't be easily undone, and asked me to confirm.

sentences.en: The agent didn't just start deleting things the moment I asked.
sentences.zh: 特工并没有在我要求的时候就开始删除东西。

sentences.en: Before it ran anything, it listed the four stacks back to me, told me plainly that this would remove all their resources and couldn't be easily undone, and asked me to confirm.
sentences.zh: 在它运行任何操作之前，它会向我列出四个堆栈，明确地告诉我这将删除它们的所有资源并且无法轻易撤消，并要求我确认。

blocks.html_en: Deleting infrastructure is not reversible.

sentences.en: Deleting infrastructure is not reversible.
sentences.zh: 删除基础设施是不可逆的。

blocks.html_en: Deleting infrastructure is not reversible.

sentences.en: Deleting infrastructure is not reversible.
sentences.zh: 删除基础设施是不可逆的。

blocks.html_en: I said go and then it acted.

sentences.en: I said go and then it acted.
sentences.zh: 我说走，然后它就行动了。

blocks.html_en: I got the speed of "just handle it" without giving up the checkpoint on a destructive action.

sentences.en: I got the speed of "just handle it" without giving up the checkpoint on a destructive action.
sentences.zh: 我得到了“处理它”的速度，而没有放弃破坏性行动的检查点。

blocks.html_en: It checked the result as code, no refreshing the console every second

sentences.en: It checked the result as code, no refreshing the console every second
sentences.zh: 它将结果检查为代码，没有每秒刷新控制台

blocks.html_en: Once the delete requests were in, the agent wrote a script and ran it in the toolkit's sandbox to check the status of all four at once.

sentences.en: Once the delete requests were in, the agent wrote a script and ran it in the toolkit's sandbox to check the status of all four at once.
sentences.zh: 一旦收到删除请求，代理就会编写一个脚本并在工具包的沙箱中运行它，以立即检查所有四个请求的状态。

blocks.html_en: It checked all four in parallel, handled the case where a stack might already be gone, and gave me back a clean status map. All of it ran in a remote sandbox with boto3. My machine never executed any of it.

sentences.en: It checked all four in parallel, handled the case where a stack might already be gone, and gave me back a clean status map.
sentences.zh: 它并行检查所有四个，处理堆栈可能已经消失的情况，并给我返回一个干净的状态图。

sentences.en: All of it ran in a remote sandbox with boto3.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都在带有 boto3 的远程沙箱中运行。

sentences.en: My machine never executed any of it.
sentences.zh: 我的机器从未执行过任何操作。

blocks.html_en: Three deleted cleanly but one refused.

sentences.en: Three deleted cleanly but one refused.
sentences.zh: 其中三个被删除干净，但一个拒绝。

blocks.html_en: The fourth stack, aws-sam-cli-managed-default, came back DELETE_FAILED.

sentences.en: The fourth stack, aws-sam-cli-managed-default, came back DELETE_FAILED.
sentences.zh: 第四个堆栈 aws-sam-cli-management-default 返回了 DELETE_FAILED。

blocks.html_en: So, the agent pulled the stack events to find out why. The failure pointed at one resource, the S3 bucket SAM uses for deployment artifacts (SamCliSourceBucket). The message was specific:

sentences.en: So, the agent pulled the stack events to find out why.
sentences.zh: 因此，代理提取了堆栈事件以找出原因。

sentences.en: The failure pointed at one resource, the S3 bucket SAM uses for deployment artifacts (SamCliSourceBucket).
sentences.zh: 故障指向一种资源，即 SAM 用于部署工件的 S3 存储桶 (SamCliSourceBucket)。

sentences.en: The message was specific:
sentences.zh: 该消息具体如下：

blocks.html_en: The bucket you tried to delete is not empty. You must delete all versions in the bucket.

sentences.en: The bucket you tried to delete is not empty.
sentences.zh: 您尝试删除的存储桶不为空。

sentences.en: You must delete all versions in the bucket.
sentences.zh: 您必须删除存储桶中的所有版本。

blocks.html_en: The bucket you tried to delete is not empty. You must delete all versions in the bucket.

sentences.en: The bucket you tried to delete is not empty.
sentences.zh: 您尝试删除的存储桶不为空。

sentences.en: You must delete all versions in the bucket.
sentences.zh: 您必须删除存储桶中的所有版本。

blocks.html_en: This bucket had versioning enabled. So "empty the bucket" isn't enough. Every object version and every delete marker has to go, or CloudFormation still can't remove the bucket. That's why a quick "empty" in the console sometimes doesn't fix it.

sentences.en: This bucket had versioning enabled.
sentences.zh: 该存储桶已启用版本控制。

sentences.en: So "empty the bucket" isn't enough.
sentences.zh: 所以“清空水桶”是不够的。

sentences.en: Every object version and every delete marker has to go, or CloudFormation still can't remove the bucket.
sentences.zh: 每个对象版本和每个删除标记都必须删除，否则 CloudFormation 仍然无法删除存储桶。

sentences.en: That's why a quick "empty" in the console sometimes doesn't fix it.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在控制台中快速“清空”有时并不能解决问题。

blocks.html_en: The agent explained the cause, then offered to empty the bucket properly and retry. I said yes.

sentences.en: The agent explained the cause, then offered to empty the bucket properly and retry.
sentences.zh: 特工解释了原因，然后提出正确清空桶并重试。

sentences.en: I said yes.
sentences.zh: 我说是的。

blocks.html_en: That whole detour, remembering the versioned-bucket gotcha, hunting down the bucket name, realising delete markers count too, emptying it manually, then coming back to retry, is the part I'd normally slog through myself. The agent connected the failed delete to the full bucket and just handled it.

sentences.en: That whole detour, remembering the versioned-bucket gotcha, hunting down the bucket name, realising delete markers count too, emptying it manually, then coming back to retry, is the part I'd normally slog through myself.
sentences.zh: 整个绕道，记住版本化存储桶陷阱，寻找存储桶名称，实现删除标记也计数，手动清空它，然后返回重试，是我通常会自己费力完成的部分。

sentences.en: The agent connected the failed delete to the full bucket and just handled it.
sentences.zh: 代理将失败的删除连接到完整存储桶并进行处理。

blocks.html_en: All four gone.

sentences.en: All four gone.
sentences.zh: 四个人都走了。

blocks.html_en: Why this felt different

sentences.en: Why this felt different
sentences.zh: 为什么这感觉不同

blocks.html_en: Let me be clear about what actually changed here, because "I used AI to delete some stacks" is not the point.

sentences.en: Let me be clear about what actually changed here, because "I used AI to delete some stacks" is not the point.
sentences.zh: 让我明确一下这里实际发生了什么变化，因为“我使用 AI 删除了一些堆栈”不是重点。

blocks.html_en: The point is the whole loop stayed in one place. I described the goal in plain language. The agent listed the real state of my account, confirmed the destructive step, ran the code to do it, and then debugged and fixed the one thing that broke without me digging through docs.

sentences.en: The point is the whole loop stayed in one place.
sentences.zh: 重点是整个循环都停留在一个地方。

sentences.en: I described the goal in plain language.
sentences.zh: 我用通俗易懂的语言描述了这个目标。

sentences.en: The agent listed the real state of my account, confirmed the destructive step, ran the code to do it, and then debugged and fixed the one thing that broke without me digging through docs.
sentences.zh: 代理列出了我帐户的真实状态，确认了破坏性步骤，运行了代码来执行此操作，然后调试并修复了在我不深入文档的情况下出现问题的一件事。

blocks.html_en: A few things made that possible:

sentences.en: A few things made that possible:
sentences.zh: 有几件事使这成为可能：

blocks.html_en: It ran real code, safely. The toolkit gives the agent a sandboxed Python runtime with boto3. It can check state, filter, and act in a few lines, without running anything on my laptop.

sentences.en: It ran real code, safely.
sentences.zh: 它安全地运行了真实的代码。

sentences.en: The toolkit gives the agent a sandboxed Python runtime with boto3.
sentences.zh: 该工具包为代理提供了带有 boto3 的沙盒 Python 运行时。

sentences.en: It can check state, filter, and act in a few lines, without running anything on my laptop.
sentences.zh: 它可以检查状态、过滤并在几行中执行操作，而无需在我的笔记本电脑上运行任何内容。

blocks.html_en: It confirmed the risky part. Deletes are one-way. The agent treated them that way and checked with me first.

sentences.en: It confirmed the risky part.
sentences.zh: 它证实了危险的部分。

sentences.en: Deletes are one-way.
sentences.zh: 删除是单向的。

sentences.en: The agent treated them that way and checked with me first.
sentences.zh: 代理人就是这样对待他们的，并首先与我核实。

blocks.html_en: It handled the failure end to end. The console wouldn't have left me stuck here. On a DELETE_FAILED, it pops up and lets me retry, either retaining the bucket (orphaning it in my account) or bouncing over to the S3 console to empty it myself. Both are context switches, and "retain" just leaves the bucket behind. The agent skipped all that. It read the stack events, found the versioned bucket, emptied it properly (versions and delete markers), and retried, without me leaving the chat or orphaning anything.

sentences.en: It handled the failure end to end.
sentences.zh: 它端到端地处理了失败。

sentences.en: The console wouldn't have left me stuck here.
sentences.zh: 控制台不会让我被困在这里。

sentences.en: On a DELETE_FAILED, it pops up and lets me retry, either retaining the bucket (orphaning it in my account) or bouncing over to the S3 console to empty it myself.
sentences.zh: 在 DELETE_FAILED 上，它会弹出并让我重试，要么保留存储桶（将其孤立在我的帐户中），要么跳到 S3 控制台自行清空它。

sentences.en: Both are context switches, and "retain" just leaves the bucket behind.
sentences.zh: 两者都是上下文切换，“保留”只是将存储桶留在后面。

sentences.en: The agent skipped all that.
sentences.zh: 代理跳过了这一切。

sentences.en: It read the stack events, found the versioned bucket, emptied it properly (versions and delete markers), and retried, without me leaving the chat or orphaning anything.
sentences.zh: 它读取堆栈事件，找到版本化存储桶，正确清空它（版本和删除标记），然后重试，而我无需离开聊天或孤立任何内容。

sentences.en: Everything is auditable.
sentences.zh: 一切都是可审计的。

sentences.en: Because this all goes through the managed AWS MCP Server, every call lands in CloudTrail.
sentences.zh: 由于这一切都通过托管 AWS MCP 服务器进行，​​因此每个调用都会进入 CloudTrail。

sentences.en: More on that next.
sentences.zh: 接下来会详细介绍。

sentences.en: I could see every call in CloudTrail

sentences.zh: 这就是将“我让代理删除我的基础设施”从可怕变成美好的部分。

blocks.html_en: The retry is right there in the trail. The aws-sam-cli-managed-default delete shows up twice: once when it failed, and again about a minute later when the agent retried after emptying the bucket. The whole failed-then-fixed sequence is preserved.

sentences.zh: aws-sam-cli-management-default 删除显示两次：一次失败时，大约一分钟后代理在清空存储桶后重试时再次显示。

blocks.html_en: One honest caveat worth knowing: the DeleteStack calls are management events, which CloudTrail logs by default. But the S3 DeleteObjects calls that actually emptied the bucket are data events, and those are not logged unless you've turned on data event logging for that bucket. So I could see the stack deletions clearly, but not the individual object deletions. If you want object-level actions in your trail, you have to enable S3 data events first.

sentences.en: One honest caveat worth knowing: the DeleteStack calls are management events, which CloudTrail logs by default.
sentences.zh: 一个值得了解的诚实警告：DeleteStack 调用是管理事件，CloudTrail 默认情况下会记录这些事件。

sentences.en: But the S3 DeleteObjects calls that actually emptied the bucket are data events, and those are not logged unless you've turned on data event logging for that bucket.
sentences.zh: 但实际清空存储桶的 S3 DeleteObjects 调用是数据事件，除非您为该存储桶打开数据事件日志记录，否则不会记录这些事件。

sentences.en: So I could see the stack deletions clearly, but not the individual object deletions.
sentences.zh: 所以我可以清楚地看到堆栈删除，但看不到单个对象删除。

sentences.en: If you want object-level actions in your trail, you have to enable S3 data events first.
sentences.zh: 如果您希望在跟踪中执行对象级操作，则必须首先启用 S3 数据事件。

content_html_zh:
它始于账单警报。

估计费用已超过 250 美元。 钱虽不吓人，但足够让我看了。 真正引起我注意的不是数字，而是警报本身。 我显然在某个时候设置了这个，但门槛感觉陈旧。

所以我去寻找警报所在的位置。

它来自我在 2014 年创建的 BillingAlerts CloudFormation 堆栈，但我完全忘记了。 所以我忘记的一件事是警告我有关我忘记的所有其他事情。

我打开我的堆栈列表，就在那时我发现它并不孤单。 它排成一排，我不认识其中的一半。 多年的剩菜，就这样坐在那里。

你忘记的东西不会破坏任何东西。 它不会在凌晨 2 点寻呼您。 它只是坐在那里，静静地计费，直到你扫一眼发票，记不起其中一半的用途。 被遗忘的、仍在运行的资源是云支出浪费的最大来源之一，据一些估计，大约占平均云预算的四分之一。

我来更新一个警报，结果发现一团糟。

需要明确的是，这些堆栈并没有真正花费我太多钱。 停止的实例，一些半删除的剩余内容。 如果是 252 美元，那么每个月都会触发警报。 但这就是重点。 在杂乱消失之前，你无法判断到底是什么让你付出了代价。

所以警报可以等待。 我希望这些陈旧的堆栈首先消失。

通常这是一件苦差事。 打开控制台，找到每个堆栈，单击删除、等待、刷新、检查它是否有效，或者写出 CLI 命令。 这并不难，只是乏味。 我一直推迟的任务。

这就是事情的开始。 通过控制台单击Ops。 我刚刚在孟买地区手动删除了一个旧的目录服务目录，点击屏幕并等待旋转器出现，当它击中我时。 手动点击仅仅十分钟，我还有一大堆要处理。 我自己不需要做任何这些事情。

为什么我还在点击？

我打开了 Kiro，其中包含适用于 AWS 的代理工具包，并描述了我想要的内容。 我之前在博客“我切换到适用于 AWS 的代理工具包”中讨论了如何设置它。 这就是为什么。

没有控制台。 不是 CLI。 我和代理聊了聊，然后让他们处理剩下的事情。 就像一个好助手！

如果您安装了 AWS CLI，只需运行：

aws configure agent-toolkit

进入全屏模式 退出全屏模式

它将允许您选择要使用 Agent Toolkit 配置的代理：

首先，告诉我那里有什么

我首先要求代理列出我所在地区的 CloudFormation 堆栈。

结果回来了 12 堆。 有些是我认识的，有些是古老的，2014 年的计费警报堆栈，2021 年的一些补丁和合规堆栈，CDK 引导工具包。 然后我真正想要的那些就消失了。

我选择并告诉代理删除其中四个堆栈。

删除前询问过

这很重要，所以我想先指出这一点。

特工并没有在我要求的时候就开始删除东西。 在它运行任何操作之前，它会向我列出四个堆栈，明确地告诉我这将删除它们的所有资源并且无法轻易撤消，并要求我确认。

删除基础设施是不可逆的。

我说走，然后它就行动了。

我得到了“处理它”的速度，而没有放弃破坏性行动的检查点。

它将结果检查为代码，没有每秒刷新控制台

一旦收到删除请求，代理就会编写一个脚本并在工具包的沙箱中运行它，以立即检查所有四个请求的状态。

它并行检查所有四个，处理堆栈可能已经消失的情况，并给我返回一个干净的状态图。 所有这些都在带有 boto3 的远程沙箱中运行。 我的机器从未执行过任何操作。

其中三个被删除干净，但一个拒绝。

第四个堆栈 aws-sam-cli-management-default 返回了 DELETE_FAILED。

因此，代理提取了堆栈事件以找出原因。 故障指向一种资源，即 SAM 用于部署工件的 S3 存储桶 (SamCliSourceBucket)。 该消息具体如下：

您尝试删除的存储桶不为空。 您必须删除存储桶中的所有版本。

该存储桶已启用版本控制。 所以“清空水桶”是不够的。 每个对象版本和每个删除标记都必须删除，否则 CloudFormation 仍然无法删除存储桶。 这就是为什么在控制台中快速“清空”有时并不能解决问题。

特工解释了原因，然后提出正确清空桶并重试。 我说是的。

整个绕道，记住版本化存储桶陷阱，寻找存储桶名称，实现删除标记也计数，手动清空它，然后返回重试，是我通常会自己费力完成的部分。 代理将失败的删除连接到完整存储桶并进行处理。

四个人都走了。

为什么这感觉不同

让我明确一下这里实际发生了什么变化，因为“我使用 AI 删除了一些堆栈”不是重点。

重点是整个循环都停留在一个地方。 我用通俗易懂的语言描述了这个目标。 代理列出了我帐户的真实状态，确认了破坏性步骤，运行了代码来执行此操作，然后调试并修复了在我不深入文档的情况下出现问题的一件事。

有几件事使这成为可能：

它安全地运行了真实的代码。 该工具包为代理提供了带有 boto3 的沙盒 Python 运行时。 它可以检查状态、过滤并在几行中执行操作，而无需在我的笔记本电脑上运行任何内容。

它证实了危险的部分。 删除是单向的。 代理人就是这样对待他们的，并首先与我核实。

它端到端地处理了失败。 控制台不会让我被困在这里。 在 DELETE_FAILED 上，它会弹出并让我重试，要么保留存储桶（将其孤立在我的帐户中），要么跳到 S3 控制台自行清空它。 两者都是上下文切换，“保留”只是将存储桶留在后面。 代理跳过了这一切。 它读取堆栈事件，找到版本化存储桶，正确清空它（版本和删除标记），然后重试，而我无需离开聊天或孤立任何内容。

一切都是可审计的。 由于这一切都通过托管 AWS MCP 服务器进行，​​因此每个调用都会进入 CloudTrail。 接下来会详细介绍。

我可以在 CloudTrail 中看到每个呼叫

这就是将“我让代理删除我的基础设施”从可怕变成美好的部分。

代理采取的每一项操作都会通过托管的 AWS MCP 服务器，并且每个调用都会显示在 CloudTrail 中。 我去看了看。 所有四个DeleteStack事件都在我的身份下，并且它们带有清晰的指纹：

eventName:        DeleteStack
userIdentity:     gaonkarr
sourceIPAddress:  aws-mcp.amazonaws.com
userAgent:        aws-mcp.amazonaws.com

进入全屏模式 退出全屏模式

aws-mcp.amazonaws.com 值是您区分代理操作与您自己操作的方式。 当天早些时候，我在控制台中手动删除了一些堆栈，这些事件看起来完全不同：真正的浏览器用户代理和我的实际 IP 地址。 因此，审计跟踪显示谁真正做了什么、我的点击与代表我行事的代理的点击。

以下是此次清理中直接来自 CloudTrail 的 5 个 DeleteStack 事件：

时间（世界标准时间） Stack 身份 源IP 用户代理
14:23:18 Cdk管道堆栈 高恩卡尔 aws-mcp.amazonaws.com aws-mcp.amazonaws.com
14:23:18 构建 sam 应用程序 高恩卡尔 aws-mcp.amazonaws.com aws-mcp.amazonaws.com
14:23:18 aws-sam-cli-management-default（第一次尝试） 高恩卡尔 aws-mcp.amazonaws.com aws-mcp.amazonaws.com
14:23:19 sam应用程序 高恩卡尔 aws-mcp.amazonaws.com aws-mcp.amazonaws.com
14:24:19 aws-sam-cli-托管-默认（重试） 高恩卡尔 aws-mcp.amazonaws.com aws-mcp.amazonaws.com

重试就在踪迹中。 aws-sam-cli-management-default 删除显示两次：一次失败时，大约一分钟后代理在清空存储桶后重试时再次显示。 整个失败然后修复的序列被保留。

一个值得了解的诚实警告：DeleteStack 调用是管理事件，CloudTrail 默认情况下会记录这些事件。 但实际清空存储桶的 S3 DeleteObjects 调用是数据事件，除非您为该存储桶打开数据事件日志记录，否则不会记录这些事件。 所以我可以清楚地看到堆栈删除，但看不到单个对象删除。 如果您希望在跟踪中执行对象级操作，则必须首先启用 S3 数据事件。

我接下来要做什么

删除四个堆栈感觉很好。 于是我就好奇的问了agent：

您可以扫描我的 AWS 账户并找出任何剩余资源吗？

它扫描了我帐户中的常用服务。 首先是默认区域，然后扩展到其他区域。 还有 4 页列表。 🫣

它从研讨会、演示和旧项目中发现了大量剩余资源，并给了我一份成本影响摘要。

  • 3 个停止的 EC2 实例，是 2021 年以来最早的一个。
  • 14 个独立的 EBS 卷，其中一些是在 2014 年创建的，仍在悄悄地为不附加任何内容的存储计费。
  • 5 个未关联的弹性 IP，不工作的地址每月大约 18 美元。
  • 122 个 S3 存储桶、一个我忘记了的负载均衡器、16 个 Lambda 函数，全部运行在多年前就已终止的运行时。

没有任何东西破坏任何东西。 这正是它能存活这么久的原因。

找到所有这些通常是最困难的部分。 单击每个区域的每项服务，一次一个控制台，是我从不这样做的原因。 在删除任何内容之前，需要花费数小时的乏味工作。 这次我问了一次，经纪人就把整个清单递给了我。

总是感觉太大而难以开始的任务现在变得容易了。

所以我要在新助理的帮助下清理它。

如果您的帐户与我的帐户类似，那么它也应该是您的。

免责声明：

请向您的代理具体说明您要删除的内容。 删除是不可逆的操作，必须小心操作！

告诉我你在那里发现了什么。 我敢打赌我不是唯一一个忘记这件事的人。
